after: turn_rule.json failed narrowly with fixed R targets (Binance T_any 2R -0.015R [-0.036, +0.005]; MT5 -0.031R) while lifting 12-bar-low entries by +0.11 to +0.15R
signal: unchanged: a 12-bar low (lowest of t-2..t at or below lowest of t-11..t-3) and bar t completes DISPLACE_C, BREACH_REVERT or DELIVERY_SHIFT the turn's way (T_any; T1-T3 reported)
entry_stop: unchanged: bar t+1's open; stop 0.1 ATR beyond the 3-bar low

exits.E1 (primary): trailing: after each completed bar the stop moves to max(current stop, best high of completed bars since entry - 2 ATR(t)); out when a bar trades through it (at the open on a gap)
exits.E2: structure: out at the next open after a DELIVERY_SHIFT against the trade (MCFL v1, known_at), or at the initial stop

costs: Binance 0.07% of price; MT5 the spread floor; walks the real series' cost in ATR units at the same bar
also: P(N R) for N in 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 10 (the most R reached before the exit) against 1/(N+1)
passes_if: T_any with E1 on Binance (1h and 4h pooled): R > 0 with day-bootstrap 90% interval above 0, positive in 2021-2023 and 2024 on, above the walk and above all 12-bar lows with the same exit
